change_policy: Any change to v1 requires a new version and a dated explanation before evaluation.
research_question: Does fund flow and momentum predict risk-adjusted returns under chronological training and conservative availability assumptions, and add long-only net value?

claims.baseline: availability-lagged chronological backtest using revised vintages
claims.strict_pit: requires separately substantiated historical values and publication dates
claims.holdings: out of scope; do not use D5
claims.sentiment: excluded from primary, revised-vintage extension only

hypotheses.H1: mean C top-minus-bottom abnormal return > 0; one-sided null <= 0
hypotheses.H2: mean paired A minus B spread > 0; one-sided null <= 0
hypotheses.economic: long-only net return relative to active and passive references after supportable costs

provenance.notes: Panel and raw data remain local and ignored by Git. Overall target summary moments were inspected during prior panel diagnostics; no model or ranked-portfolio evaluation has been run.

sample.missing_features: exclude from scoring at formation; report count, no imputation
sample.missing_outcomes: preserve formation and selected weights; do not set zero or renormalize; mark affected portfolio month missing

availability.target_availability: end of formation month plus two months, conditional on available data
availability.evidence: assumptions, not independently verified publication dates

target.beta_role: ex-post outcome construction; not a formation-date feature
target.target_membership: share classes selected at formation; preserve missing future returns

features.momentum: mean abnormal return t-11 through t-1, minimum 8
features.flow_C: fund flow from return month t-1 using available lagged-TNA class aggregation
features.flow_A_B: same flow definition applied to contemporaneous month t retrospectively, using fixed formation membership
features.eligibility: canonical lagged formation rules; no conditioning on future outcome
features.preprocessing: complete features only; training-only mean and population standard deviation; zero-variance feature invalidates fit

A.training: three random month folds; one train, one validation, one test, rotate
A.fold_assignment: sort 2002-01 through 2025-10 by SHA256 of UTF-8 string 5253|YYYY-MM; assign first 96, next 95, last 95 to folds 0,1,2
A.interpretation: retrospective diagnostic; future months may train earlier predictions

D.feature_timing: C plus revised sentiment and explicit linear interactions

experiments.comparison: primary C ranks on its own ex-ante eligible universe; matched A/B/C portfolio comparisons are ex-post diagnostics with missingness and full-universe results reported separately

model.primary: ridge with unpenalized intercept; minimize sum squared error plus alpha times squared coefficient norm
model.validation: equal weight per formation month, mean squared prediction error
model.initial_tuning: walk-forward validation in 2017-01 through 2018-12; only labels available by 2019-02-28
model.subsequent_tuning: each January, use most recent 24 formation months whose outcomes are available by decision; walk-forward validation using data available at each historical validation date
model.refit: each month, all available eligible earlier labels after tuning

portfolio.deciles: sort ascending prediction, ties by fund_id ascending; assign floor(10*zero_based_rank/n)+1
portfolio.primary_economic: long-only top decile on reported net class returns
portfolio.retail_class_rule: among classes with lagged retail/open indicators and known expense, lowest known expense; ties by crsp_fundno
portfolio.retail_access: proxy only unless minimums, investor access and opening status are independently verified
portfolio.unavailable_month: no month return if any positive-weight selected constituent lacks realized return; no zero substitution or renormalization
portfolio.cost_note: illustrative one-way transaction-cost scenarios applied separately to buys and sells; not estimates of actual fees; 25 bps central
portfolio.benchmark: equal-weight eligible active funds; Mkt-RF plus RF is a gross market research proxy, not investable. An independently sourced net passive benchmark is required for an investable passive comparison.
portfolio.execution: next available NAV after formation; monthly return alignment is a proxy until execution timing and restrictions are verified

inference.unit: monthly portfolio return or paired monthly difference
inference.method: overlapping 12-calendar-month moving-block bootstrap, blocks only within contiguous observed runs
inference.p_value: one-sided null-centered bootstrap on monthly means with plus-one adjustment
inference.short_series: if no contiguous 12-month block exists, do not report bootstrap inference
inference.selection_bias: report missing month counts and concentration; inference conditional on observed months

freeze_conditions: No numeric outcome performance has been evaluated for a ranking or portfolio.
Reconcile lagged and retrospective features and missing targets before launching evaluation.
Obtain or label access restrictions and passive benchmark limitations.
If settings or data hashes must change, register a new protocol version with a dated rationale before outcome evaluation.
